title: 新加坡湯申—東海岸線~Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line
focus: 分期地下捷運通車與系統界面管理~Staged underground metro openings and interface management
summary: 以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。~Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 work_length=556.4 m；單元 2 得 combinations=64 states；單元 3 得 sigma=1.795841 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 setup 的擾動測試，結果改為 538.04 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives work_length=556.4 m; unit 2 gives combinations=64 states; unit 3 gives sigma=1.795841 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing setup in the first unit changes its result to 538.04 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2020 年：湯申東海岸線第一階段開始旅客服務；2021 年：湯申東海岸線第二階段於八月開放營運；2022 年：湯申東海岸線第三階段於十一月開放營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2020: Thomson–East Coast Line Stage 1 began passenger service; 2021: Thomson–East Coast Line Stage 2 opened in August; 2022: Thomson–East Coast Line Stage 3 opened in November. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.mechanism: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把延伸線接續窗口分為隔離、施工、測試及還路。~A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Split the extension connection window into isolation, construction, testing and handback.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 50.49 min，其餘固定，結果為 538.04 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 50.49 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 538.04 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.
units.verify: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。~Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.
units.failure: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。~Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.
units.misconception: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量~The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
units.practice: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對營運端與施工端建立明確互斥進路和隔離狀態。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Establish explicit route exclusion and isolation states between operating and construction sections.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 比較延伸前後定位參考表，檢查資料版本一致性。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Compare localisation reference tables before and after extension and check version consistency.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在延伸設備通訊延遲時驗證既有區段仍維持安全狀態。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Verify the existing section retains a safe state when extension-equipment communication is delayed.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3366 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.415 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3366 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.415 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 將新增列車負載帶入供電回路，重新估算最遠端電壓。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Add new train loads to the supply loop and re-estimate the far-end receiving voltage.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1530 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=91.8 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1683 A，其餘固定，結果為 100.98 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1530 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=91.8 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1683 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 100.98 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.mechanism: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 讓新站門位與既有車輛停準配對量測，區分隨機及共同偏差。~Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Pair new station door-position measurements with existing vehicle stops and distinguish random from shared error.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.08976 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09317649 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified.
units.verify: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。~Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution.
units.failure: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。~Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.
units.misconception: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移~A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
units.practice: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 比較新轉乘路徑開放前後的步行與等候分布。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Compare walking and waiting distributions before and after a new interchange path opens.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 隨新增地下站重新界定一般通風的體積和換氣需求。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Redefine normal ventilation volume and air-change demand as underground stations are added.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.05 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 246.2658 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.05 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 246.2658 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 檢查新舊排水區域連接是否改變泵浦停機的積水邊界。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Check whether linked drainage zones change accumulation boundaries during pump downtime.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.244e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.343332 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.244e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.343332 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.title: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 辨認新增備援設備是否仍依賴同一機房或電源。~When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Identify whether added backup equipment still depends on one equipment room or supply.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02244 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006732 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02244 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006732 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.
units.verify: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。~Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.
units.failure: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。~Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.
units.misconception: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低~Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
units.practice: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
